name: PSYCHIC
text: A tag with no effect of its own. Rules of other teams read it (the Null Rod switches PSYCHIC weapons off nearby).

name: Headtaker
text: When the Gorehorn incapacitates an operative with the skullcleaver it rolls a D3: it regains that many lost wounds (not while frenzied), and for the rest of the battle the skullcleaver's Critical Dmg rises by the result, to no more than 8.

name: Tactual Hunter
text: When the Mangler fights (not retaliates) with the vicious claws against an expended enemy, the first time it strikes with a critical success it may at once strike with another of its successes, before the enemy resolves one.

name: Vicious Blows
text: While the Vandal fights (not retaliates), the mancrusher has Ceaseless.

name: Frenzy
text: A friendly Fellgor Ravager that would be incapacitated is not: it gains a Frenzy token, every remaining attack die of that sequence is discarded (both sides of a fight), and a Conceal order becomes Engage. Your opponent counts it as incapacitated at once. A frenzied operative is Engage only, injured (Warriors excepted), cannot pick up markers or use unique or mission actions (Sweeping Blow excepted), counts as APL 1 for control, and dies only when its activation or counteraction ends, a critical strike or a critical shooting hit lands on it, two normal strikes have landed on it, or two normal shooting hits land in one Shoot, or the battle ends.
source: team-fellgor-ravagers.pdf (Aug '26); docs/spec/13-teams.md T-FG.29, T-FG.30, T-FG.31, T-FG.32

name: Call the Attack
text: STRATEGIC GAMBIT while the Ironhorn is in the killzone and not frenzied: pick a friendly Fellgor Ravager the Ironhorn can see within 6 inches (itself included). That operative and every other friendly Fellgor Ravager it can see within 2 inches may each take a free Dash, in the order you choose.

name: Icon Bearer
text: Frenzy never lowers the Deathknell's APL for control, and when control of a marker is worked out its APL counts 1 higher.

name: War Gong
text: While the Deathknell is not frenzied, an attack die that would deal Critical Dmg to a friendly Fellgor Ravager within 3 inches of it (itself included) may deal the attacker's Normal Dmg instead.

name: GONG KNELL
text: Until the start of the Deathknell's next activation, or its incapacitation, its Save is 1 better whenever it is shot.

name: Blade Whirl
text: When the Fluxbray fights or retaliates and is not frenzied, it may resolve one of its successes first, before anything else; that success must block.

name: CLEAVER FLURRY
text: Not in an enemy control range, not on Conceal, and not after a Reposition, Fall Back or Charge this activation (the free Reposition counts as one). The Fluxbray makes a free Reposition with 2 inches more movement, during which it may pass through enemy control ranges (it may not end in one). Each enemy whose control range it passed through then takes D3+1 damage, in the order it was passed.

name: Sagacious
text: When the Gnarlscar's activation ends, you may change its order.

name: UNCOMPROMISING ATTACK
text: The Gnarlscar takes a free Fight and then a free Shoot, or the Shoot first and then the Fight. The Shoot may be made in an enemy control range (it must then target an enemy in its own control range) and may only use the autopistol. Both count as the Fight and Shoot actions of the activation, so a part already taken this activation is skipped.

name: Champion
text: The Gorehorn may take the Fight action twice in one activation.

name: Whip Control
text: While an enemy is visible to and within 3 inches of the Herd-Goad and the Herd-Goad is not in the control range of any other enemy, that enemy's melee weapons have 1 less Atk (never below 1) and its Fall Back costs 1 extra AP.

name: INCITE FURY
text: Not in an enemy control range. Pick another friendly Fellgor Ravager (not a Shaman or an Ironhorn) the Herd-Goad can see within 3 inches: it has 1 more APL until the end of its next activation.

name: Berserker
text: The Mangler can never Shoot, and when it guards it may only Fight. Pick Up Marker and mission actions cost it 1 more AP.

name: Savage
text: The first time in each activation the Mangler takes the Fight action, it may at once take another free Fight, against the same enemy or another. Ruthless Rampage cannot be used between the two Fights.

name: APOPLECTIC REJUVENATION
text: Not in an enemy control range. A friendly Fellgor Ravager that is not frenzied and that the Shaman can see within 6 inches regains up to 2D3 lost wounds, or up to 6 if it has incapacitated an enemy while fighting or retaliating at any time this battle.

name: MANTLE OF DARKNESS
text: PSYCHIC. Not in an enemy control range. Until the start of the Shaman's next activation, or its incapacitation, friendly Fellgor Ravagers the Shaman can see within 3 inches that have a Conceal order and are in cover cannot be picked as targets, whatever the shooter's rules, unless the shooter is within 2 inches.

name: Toxic Blessings
text: The Toxhorn may ignore APL decreases, enemy Shock never affects it, and when an attack die deals it Normal Dmg of 3 or more it rolls a D6: on a 5+ that damage is 1 lower.

name: Pox Bomb
text: The Toxhorn can throw a Stun Grenade without the team taking it. When an enemy fails to shrug off a Stun Grenade the Toxhorn threw (its own or the team's) and its test result is 3 or more, it also takes damage equal to half that result, rounded up.

name: STUN GRENADE (POX BOMB)
text: Not in an enemy control range. Throw a Stun Grenade at a visible enemy within 6 inches: it and everything within 1 inch test on a D6 and lose 1 APL on a 3 or more; an enemy that rolls 3 or more also takes damage equal to half the roll, rounded up.

name: SWEEPING BLOW
text: Not on Conceal. Every other operative, friend or foe, the Vandal can see within 2 inches takes D3+1 damage, rolled separately, enemies first. A frenzied Vandal may still do this.

name: Warrior Frenzy
text: While a Warrior is frenzied it is never injured.
